question: Can a law that composes like cycles have a circuit that overlaps modulo the tops? In particular, which Latin squares have 3-net laws that compose like cycles, and are their knot top images functional, with a polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops on the knot ranges?

definitions.law, system, circuit, tie, knot, range,: as in CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001; laws here are multi-sorted: each relation has a signature of sorts and a variable only fills positions of its own sort
definitions.3-net law: three sorts X, Y, Z, each a copy of the square's symbols, and the one relation {(x, y, x o y)}
definitions.group isotope: a Latin square whose principal loop isotope (at the first row and column) is associative; this holds exactly when the square is isotopic to a group
definitions.gadgets: fixed 3-net systems: shared diagonal x1oy1 = x0oy0, with x1oy0 and x0oy1 free labels; two diagonals x0oy0 = x1oy1 and x0oy1 = x1oy0; three-cycle x0oy_i = x1oy_(i+1) for i mod 3; the 4-cycle with four distinct labels
definitions.candidate top: on a range found, the partition generated by the proper reflexive relations observed (two-variable projections between variables with that range, fibre-sharing relations of circuits at each variable)
definitions.collapse: a candidate top that is the total relation on a range with two or more values. Each observed relation is pp-definable, proper and reflexive, so in a law that composes like cycles it lies below the unique maximal proper pp-definable equivalence (CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001, Lemma 1). A collapse therefore certifies that the law does not compose like cycles
definitions.certified top: a candidate top for which every strictly coarser proper equivalence is broken by a ternary polymorphism in a pool
definitions.functional, overlapping, neither: the kinds of a knot's top image at each variable: every fibre a single top class; every two top classes sharing a fibre; anything else
definitions.Mal'tsev modulo the tops on knot ranges: ternary operation tables, one per sort, preserving every relation, with F(x,y,y) in x's top class and F(x,x,y) in y's on every knot range; an exactly Mal'tsev table is searched first

laws.3-nets of non-group squares: the non-group isotopy class of order 5 (a fixed square), a non-group square of order 6 that passed the shared-diagonal gadget in scoping, and four non-group squares of order 6 and two of order 7 drawn with seed 20261021
laws.overlapping knots: e = x + yH over Zp on three sorts for (p, H) = (5, {1,4}), (7, {1,6}), (7, {1,2,4}); the equality indicator y = [a != b] with a, b in {0,1,2}
laws.controls: three-variable even parity; the Boolean neither-knot

public_inputs.systems: the gadgets first (3-nets only), then random systems with seed 20261021 per law: 1 to 6 constraints, each on variables of the right sorts, reusing an existing variable with probability 0.55 up to the size cap; counts and caps by largest sort: up to 3 symbols 2000 systems of up to 8 variables, 4-5 symbols 1500 of up to 8, 6-7 symbols 600 of up to 7, 8 symbols 300 of up to 6
public_inputs.searches: generalized arc consistency with backtracking over one ternary table per sort; 150 seconds per phase for sorts of up to 7 symbols and 1200 for 8; skipped when a relation has more than 80 tuples

forbidden_inputs: no top, witness or operation is entered by hand: tops come from observed relations and operations from the solver

predictions.H1: every non-group square's 3-net law has an elimination failure or a collapse
predictions.H2: the 3-net laws of the abelian p-groups Z2, Z3, Z4, Z2xZ2, Z5, Z7, Z8 and Z2xZ4 have neither, and that of Z6 has one
predictions.H2b: the 3-net laws of S3 and D4 collapse (their involutions generate the group), and that of Q8 has neither (its only involution is -1)
predictions.H3: every overlapping-knot law (the three e = x + yH laws and the equality indicator) has a failure or a collapse
predictions.H4: every surviving law's knot top images are functional at every variable
predictions.H5: every surviving law has a ternary polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops on its knot ranges
predictions.H6: in every surviving law no circuit hides below the tops and every tie's top image is a bijection (proved in CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001)

primary_observable: per law: the first failure with its system and source, or the collapsed ranges, or the ranges, knot ranges, tops with certificates, the Mal'tsev outcome with its tables, and counts of hidden circuits, bijective ties and functional, overlapping or neither knot images
cheapest_meaningful_control: (C1) parity has neither and a Mal'tsev operation; (C2) the neither-knot fails; (C3) the non-group square of order 5 fails on the shared-diagonal gadget, as in scoping; (C4) the 3-net of Z6 fails or collapses (its mod-2 and mod-3 relations are pp-definable)
independent_check: check_result.py, with its own code: re-verifies every failure by brute force; re-verifies every collapse by recomputing the relations of the recorded witness systems and their join; re-verifies every recorded table as a polymorphism with its conditions and every certificate; replicates the hidden-circuit, tie and knot counts on fresh systems for every surviving law; recomputes the group-isotope test and the flags
decision_or_followup_rule: A signal is H1-H6 holding with all controls passing. A surviving law with an overlapping knot image modulo certified tops would refute the Latin conjecture and become ticket B's subject; a surviving non-group square would contradict H1 and be examined there.
first_executable_signal: Scoping on 2026-10-21 (not evidence): every overlapping candidate tried failed in systems of six to eight variables (the equality indicator; e = x + yH over Z5 and Z7); non-group squares of orders 5 and 6 failed only once labels were shared (on K_{3,3} with distinct labels the order-5 one even gave the graphic matroid); the S3 and D4 3-nets collapsed and the Q8 3-net did not in a small-budget dry run, whose Mal'tsev search for Q8 timed out at a 60-second cap.
stop_rule: Stop after the declared roster or budget; stop early only on a solver or control failure.
nonclaims: Finite random samples and fixed gadgets: a law with no failure or collapse is not proved to compose like cycles.
Ranges and knot ranges are those found in the samples.
A search that ends without an operation, or times out, proves nothing.
No claim about native structure, distance or physics.
